note: THE ONE axis alias table. Keys are the canonical axis ids exactly as GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc spells them (axes[].axis). Values are the other spellings a caller meets: the board row's own dataset code (csoai/gspc-<code> -> <code> and gspc-<code>) and the gspc-<axis> spelling the signed card index uses. Nothing else is an alias: an index name with no grounded link to a board row (arc-30, care-refusal-help, jail-escape-detection, swarm-candidates, ...) stays its own name. Resolution is case-insensitive: trim, lowercase, canonical match first, then alias. Byte-identical copies ship in mcp/gspc-server/axis-aliases.json (npm) and scripts/spray/pypi/csoai-gspc/csoai_gspc/axis_aliases.json (PyPI); functions/mcp/axis-aliases.test.ts fails if a copy drifts or a key stops being a board row.
